thread:
kevin: Customer reporting tool-invoke failure in golden-eval CI. Error: schema validation failed - "expected object, got string". Customer acct-8342. Happened during function_call test for /v1/generate-tool. Request ID r-abc123. Repro steps: ran eval job, one test failed intermittently.

anya: Can you paste the exact failure log and the golden prompt used? Is this affecting hosted only or dedicated too? @samir oncall?

kevin: Logs:
```
ERROR RuntimeValidation: tool_invoke_payload: expected object, got string
at validator.js:45
Request r-abc123
Model: redwood-clarity-5b
Tool: calendar.create_event
args: "{\"title\":\"Q2 planning\", \"time\":\"2026-04-01T10:00:00Z\"}"
```
Note args look like a quoted JSON string instead of an object.

ci-bot: CI job: https://ci.redwood.com/job/evals/4567 - flaky test flagged (2/10 failures). Triggered by commit 9c1f2b.

samir: Sounds like the eval harness is double-serializing args. Could be a change in the test runner that started stringifying tool args before call. I saw a related change in the eval harness serializer in last week's PR #1186.

lina: Customer also reported higher latency on that run but auth/billing look fine from their account. They're escalated and asking for timeline.

anya: Quick triage plan:
1) Reproduce locally: run the failing golden prompt with the eval harness commit 9c1f2b.
2) Inspect serializer in test runner for toString() or JSON.stringify wrappers.
3) Add a unit test asserting that tool args are parsed as objects (schema enforcement).
4) If found, revert the eval harness change or patch serializer + ship a hotfix to CI.

kevin: Repro steps I used:
- clone repo @9c1f2b
- ./scripts/run_golden_eval --filter="calendar.create_event"
- observe validator error

samir: I'll pull a dev container and run it now. If it's an eval runner bug we can hotfix the harness. If it's model output change (e.g., model started emitting quoted JSON), we'll need a runtime defensive parse: attempt JSON.parse on string args then validate.

anya: For CI/regression side: add a golden prompt regression test that asserts schema type of tool args. Also pin the eval-runner version in CI to avoid flakiness during rollback.

lina: I'll inform the customer: temporary mitigation - re-run job after we pin CI to previous harness; ETA 2-4 hours. Will offer dedicated help if needed.

kevin: Thanks. @samir keep us posted. If you find it's model drift, raise on eng-ml and we'll add a pre-serve sanitizer.

samir: Update: reproduced, serializer indeed wraps args in quotes when prompts include trailing inline code blocks. Opening PR to strip extra stringify in harness: https://github.com/redwood/evah-runner/pull/1190 :thumbsup:

kevin: Awesome. After PR lands, we'll rerun the golden eval and mark customer case RESOLVED if green. Also adding CI test and a short note in the release changelog.

anya: Adding test: assert typeof parsed_args === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed_args)

lina: Noted, will update customer and close loop. :white_check_mark:
